triggers.detailsText: ● Record capacity expansion: Added 11.7k desks in Q2 FY27 - largest-ever capacity addition, taking operational capacity to 145.3k desks (+8.8% QoQ; +26.9% YoY). Over the last 12 months, the company added 29.8k members against a capacity addition of 30.8k desks, with member additions accounting for 97% of capacity additions. PAT increased +67.4% YoY to ₹ 65.8 Cr (+23.7% QoQ), with PAT margins at 8.6% (+183 bps YoY; +94 bps QoQ), underscoring the company's ability to strengthen proﬁtability while undertaking signiﬁcant capacity investments.
filingKeyFacts: ● Record capacity expansion: Added 11.7k desks in Q2 FY27 - largest-ever capacity addition, taking operational capacity to 145.3k desks (+8.8% QoQ; +26.9% YoY).
Over the last 12 months, the company added 29.8k members against a capacity addition of 30.8k desks, with member additions accounting for 97% of capacity additions.

PAT increased +67.4% YoY to ₹ 65.8 Cr (+23.7% QoQ), with PAT margins at 8.6% (+183 bps YoY; +94 bps QoQ), underscoring the company's ability to strengthen proﬁtability while undertaking signiﬁcant capacity investments.
